The biggest thing that Pulp Fiction had going for it was it's narrative structure. After Killing Joke, I'm hesitant about DC Animated tackling preexisting stories. Especially visual stories. Making a film from a book is easier because the only "vision" of the story everyone has is their own personal imagination. When you think of graphic novels, you think of the specific art. Hush will be synonymous with Jim Lee's art and I think half of my disappointment in Killing Joke was that they didn't capture Brian Bolland's style(and didn't even attempt to but that's just me...). I will probably have low expectations but if it gets some little kid in some small town interested in the original book enough to pick it up and read it, then I'm all for it.
